Amethyst.description: Inlaid with deep purple crystals that guard against mental manipulation.

features.name: Amethyst Kashrishi
features.tldr: You gain strong resistance against mental effects and psychic intrusion.

Quartz.description: Resonating with clear quartz that sharpens your everyday senses.

features.name: Quartz Kashrishi
features.tldr: You gain low-light vision and an intuitive bonus to notice hidden creatures.
